baselines.name: latest_visible_failure
baselines.description: Deterministic heuristic that predicts the deepest/latest visible failed stage; failure class from FailureClassifier on that stage's log. No LLM and no memory.

baselines.name: llm_log_only
baselines.description: Model receives bounded failure-log evidence only (prompt research/prompts/b1_log_only.v1.txt); strict JSON output schema.
baselines.note: The legacy corpus-level ci_failure_orchestrator.baselines.run_baseline still rejects B1 (fail closed). Results count only with a claim-eligible provider (recorded or command); the mock provider is a pipeline check.

baselines.name: llm_repo_context
baselines.description: Model receives failure logs plus bounded failure-time repository context (context policy ctx-v1; prompt research/prompts/b2_context.v1.txt).

baselines.name: dependency_graph_only
baselines.description: Dependency-aware root-cause ranking (RootCauseRanker) without memory or LLM reasoning; failure class from FailureClassifier on the top-ranked stage's log.

baselines.name: dependency_graph_llm
baselines.description: Model receives logs, bounded context, the dependency graph and the B3 ranking (prompt research/prompts/b4_graph_context.v1.txt), without persistent failure memory.

baselines.name: ci_green_acceptance_single_attempt
baselines.description: Repair-track comparator: accept the first scripted candidate that turns the visible CI command green; one attempt; no policy, no verification.

baselines.name: ci_green_acceptance_k_attempts
baselines.description: As R-GREEN-1 with the same retry budget k as P.

baselines.name: proposed_full_system
baselines.description: Repair track: the real run_fix_repo loop (retry engine, policy gate, forbidden-diff detection, independent verification) driven by scripted candidates. Diagnosis track: identical to B3, because failure memory is not exercised by the research harness.
baselines.research_entrypoint: research.repair (system P); ablations P-no-policy, P-no-verification, P-no-retry
not_evaluated: real CI confirmation (require_real_ci is refused on fixtures)

registry_changes: 1.2: B1, B2 and B4 implemented in the research harness; repair-track comparators R-GREEN-1/R-GREEN-k added; B3 uses_repo_context corrected to false and P's flags corrected to what the harness exercises (no LLM, no memory).
rule: No baseline may be silently improved after test-set evaluation. Material changes require a new baseline version. Unimplemented baselines fail closed.
